# Scope and analysis plan {-}

This report independently analyzes the extracted individual observations for three protein fractions:

- Myofibrillar
- Mitochondrial
- Cytosolic

For every fraction, it generates **Fraction New**, **Turnover**, and **Synthesis** figures for:

1. Adult versus Old Control
2. Old Control, Old Exercise, and Old Rapamycin, with two **pre-specified treatment contrasts**: Exercise versus Control and Rapamycin versus Control. No omnibus old-treatment effect and no Exercise-versus-Rapamycin comparison are tested.

The nonlinear model is fitted independently in R to each fraction/group:

\[
Y(t)=Plateau\left(1-e^{-Kt}\right)
\]

with `Y0 = 0`, `0 <= Plateau <= 1`, `K > 0`, ordinary unweighted least squares, individual replicate observations, and the observations excluded in Prism omitted. `Plateau` is the Dynamic fraction, `1 - Plateau` is the Resistant fraction, and `K` is the synthesis rate constant.

The Prism fit values are used **only for validation** and are not supplied to the R models. The Adult-versus-Old statistical result is also validated against the existing Prism reference. The old-treatment inference is intentionally updated from the previous Prism one-way ANOVA/Tukey workflow to the two planned contrasts used throughout the current treatment analyses, so those new treatment p-values are calculated directly in R rather than validated against the legacy Prism ANOVA/Tukey table.

> **To run:** put `Turn_raw.csv`, `Turn_prism_fit.csv`, `Turn_prism_stats.csv` and the `R/` folder next to this file, then knit. Packages must be installed beforehand (checked in *Packages*). Figures are written to `TurnAll/` and previews are embedded in the report right after the chunk that creates them.

# Packages {-}

All packages must be installed beforehand (the script stops and lists any that are missing; it does not install anything). They are attached in the original order, which decides which functions mask which.

```{r packages}
pkgs <- c("ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr", "readr", "purrr", "tibble", "minpack.lm", "ragg",
          "patchwork", "ggpattern", "svglite")
missing_pkgs <- pkgs[!vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  stop("Install missing packages first: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}
invisible(lapply(pkgs, library, character.only = TRUE))
```

```{r nm-inline-figures, echo=FALSE}
# Show every exported figure in the report, right after the chunk that creates it.
# Previews are redrawn from the plot objects at screen resolution and embedded in the HTML;
# the 600-dpi PNG/SVG files in the output folder are unchanged.
inline_figures <- TRUE   # FALSE = write figure files only, do not embed previews
inline_dpi     <- 110    # preview resolution (lower = smaller HTML)
inline_zoom    <- 1.5    # on-screen scale relative to the physical panel size
inline_registry <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
inline_queue    <- character(0)
inline_dir      <- file.path(tempdir(), "inline_figures")
dir.create(inline_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# save_nm_plot() is wrapped (not edited): it still writes exactly the same files, and
# additionally records the plot so the hook below can preview it.
save_nm_plot_original <- save_nm_plot
save_nm_plot <- function(plot, file_stub, size_key, width_mm = NULL, height_mm = NULL, dpi = 600) {
  res <- save_nm_plot_original(plot = plot, file_stub = file_stub, size_key = size_key,
                               width_mm = width_mm, height_mm = height_mm, dpi = dpi)
  dims <- nm_dims[[size_key]]
  id <- basename(file_stub)
  assign(id, list(plot = plot,
                  width = if (is.null(width_mm)) unname(dims[["width"]]) else width_mm,
                  height = if (is.null(height_mm)) unname(dims[["height"]]) else height_mm),
         envir = inline_registry)
  inline_queue <<- c(inline_queue, id)
  invisible(res)
}

nm_inline_html <- function() {
  ids <- unique(inline_queue)
  inline_queue <<- character(0)
  parts <- vapply(ids, function(id) {
    tryCatch({
      e <- get(id, envir = inline_registry, inherits = FALSE)
      f <- file.path(inline_dir, paste0(id, ".png"))
      ggplot2::ggsave(f, e$plot, width = e$width, height = e$height, units = "mm",
                      dpi = inline_dpi, bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png, limitsize = FALSE)
      paste0("<div style='margin:8px 0 16px 0;'><div style='font-size:80%; font-family:monospace;'>", id,
             "</div><img alt='", id, "' src='", knitr::image_uri(f),
             "' style='width:", round(e$width * inline_zoom), "mm; max-width:100%;'/></div>")
    }, error = function(err) {
      paste0("<p><em>Preview not available for ", id, ": ", conditionMessage(err), "</em></p>")
    })
  }, character(1))
  paste(parts, collapse = "\n")
}

knitr::knit_hooks$set(nm_inline = function(before, options, envir) {
  if (before || !isTRUE(inline_figures)) return(NULL)
  out <- tryCatch(nm_inline_html(), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(out) || !nzchar(out)) NULL else paste0("\n\n", out, "\n\n")
})
knitr::opts_chunk$set(nm_inline = TRUE)
```

```{r helpers}
pt_to_geom <- function(pt) {

format_p <- function(p, prefix = "p") {
  if (!is.finite(p)) {
    return(paste0(prefix, "=NA"))
  }
  if (p < 0.001) {
    return(paste0(prefix, "<0.001"))
  }
  paste0(prefix, "=", sprintf("%.3f", p))
```

# Fit the one-phase association model in R

```{r fits}
fit_one_phase <- function(df) {
  start_plateau <- min(max(df$Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.10, 0.95)
  if (!is.finite(start_plateau) || start_plateau <= 0) {
    start_plateau <- 0.8
  }

  minpack.lm::nlsLM(
    Value ~ Plateau * (1 - exp(-K * Time_days)),
    data = df,
    start = list(Plateau = start_plateau, K = 0.03),
    lower = c(Plateau = 0, K = 1e-10),
    upper = c(Plateau = 1, K = Inf),
    control = minpack.lm::nls.lm.control(
      maxiter = 1000,
      ftol = 1e-12,
      ptol = 1e-12,
      gtol = 1e-12
    )
  )
}

fit_table <- raw_fit %>%
  group_by(Fraction, Group) %>%
  tidyr::nest() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Key = paste(as.character(Fraction), as.character(Group), sep = "||"),
    Fit = purrr::map(data, fit_one_phase)
  )

fit_lookup <- stats::setNames(fit_table$Fit, fit_table$Key)

extract_fit <- function(fit, fraction, group) {
  co <- stats::coef(fit)
  se <- sqrt(diag(stats::vcov(fit)))
  fitted_values <- stats::fitted(fit)
  residual_values <- stats::residuals(fit)
  observed <- fitted_values + residual_values
  rss <- sum(residual_values^2)
  tss <- sum((observed - mean(observed))^2)

  tibble(
    Fraction = as.character(fraction),
    Group = as.character(group),
    N = length(observed),
    Plateau = unname(co["Plateau"]),
    Plateau_SE = unname(se["Plateau"]),
    K = unname(co["K"]),
    K_SE = unname(se["K"]),
    Half_time_days = log(2) / unname(co["K"]),
    R2 = 1 - rss / tss,
    RSS = rss,
    Dynamic = unname(co["Plateau"]),
    Resistant = 1 - unname(co["Plateau"])
  )
}

fit_results <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  list(fit_table$Fit, fit_table$Fraction, fit_table$Group),
  extract_fit
) %>%
  mutate(
    Fraction = factor(Fraction, levels = fraction_levels),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Fraction, Group)

stopifnot(
  nrow(fit_results) == length(fraction_levels) * length(group_levels),
  all(fit_results$Plateau >= 0 & fit_results$Plateau <= 1),
  all(fit_results$K > 0),
  all(abs(fit_results$Dynamic + fit_results$Resistant - 1) < 1e-10)
)

print(fit_results, n = Inf)
readr::write_csv(fit_results, file.path(out_dir, "Fit_summary.csv"))
```

# Validate the R fits against Prism

```{r fit-validation}
prism_fit <- readr::read_csv(prism_fit_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

fit_validation <- fit_results %>%
  mutate(
    Fraction = as.character(Fraction),
    Group = as.character(Group)
  ) %>%
  left_join(prism_fit, by = c("Fraction", "Group")) %>%
  mutate(
    N_difference = N - N_Prism,
    Plateau_difference = Plateau - Plateau_Prism,
    Plateau_SE_difference = Plateau_SE - Plateau_SE_Prism,
    K_difference = K - K_Prism,
    K_SE_difference = K_SE - K_SE_Prism,
    R2_difference = R2 - R2_Prism,
    At_upper_plateau_boundary =
      Plateau_Prism >= 1 - 1e-8 &
      Plateau >= 1 - 1e-8,
    K_match =
      abs(K_difference) < 5e-6 |
      (At_upper_plateau_boundary & abs(K_difference) < 2e-5),
    Fit_pass =
      N_difference == 0 &
      abs(Plateau_difference) < 5e-6 &
      K_match &
      abs(R2_difference) < 5e-6,
    Fit_note = if_else(
      At_upper_plateau_boundary,
      "Plateau reached the imposed upper boundary; K may vary slightly by optimizer",
      "Interior solution"
    )
  )

print(
  fit_validation %>%
    select(
      Fraction,
      Group,
      N_difference,
      Plateau_difference,
      K_difference,
      R2_difference,
      Fit_note,
      Fit_pass
    ),
  n = Inf
)

stopifnot(all(fit_validation$Fit_pass))
readr::write_csv(fit_validation, file.path(out_dir, "Fit_validation.csv"))
```

# Statistical comparisons from fitted parameter summaries

The inferential strategy now mirrors the rest of the old-treatment analyses:

- **Adult versus Old Control:** one two-sided unpaired Student t-test with equal variances.
- **Old treatments:** two pre-specified treatment contrasts only:
  1. Exercise versus Control
  2. Rapamycin versus Control
- There is **no omnibus treatment test** and no Exercise-versus-Rapamycin comparison.

For each fitted parameter, `SD = SE * sqrt(n)` is used to reconstruct the summary variance. The two old-treatment contrast p-values are retained as raw planned-comparison p-values and are also Holm-adjusted within each Fraction × Metric for reference.

```{r statistics}
summary_pair_t_test <- function(
  data,
  fraction,
  metric,
  groups,
  analysis_set,
  contrast = NA_character_
) {
  se_name <- paste0(metric, "_SE")

  d <- data %>%
    filter(Fraction == fraction, Group %in% groups) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = groups)) %>%
    arrange(Group)

  stopifnot(nrow(d) == 2)

  means <- d[[metric]]
  ses <- d[[se_name]]
  n <- d$N
  sds <- ses * sqrt(n)
  df <- sum(n) - 2
  pooled_variance <- sum((n - 1) * sds^2) / df
  se_difference <- sqrt(pooled_variance * sum(1 / n))
  t_value <- (means[1] - means[2]) / se_difference
  p_value <- 2 * stats::pt(-abs(t_value), df = df)

  tibble(
    Analysis_set = analysis_set,
    Contrast = contrast,
    Fraction = fraction,
    Metric = metric,
    Test = "Planned unpaired Student t test",
    Group_1 = groups[1],
    Group_2 = groups[2],
    Mean_difference = means[1] - means[2],
    SE_difference = se_difference,
    Statistic = abs(t_value),
    DF_numerator = NA_real_,
    DF_denominator = df,
    P_value = p_value,
    P_adjusted = NA_real_
  )
}

ao_tests <- tidyr::crossing(
  Fraction = fraction_levels,
  Metric = c("Plateau", "K")
) %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(
    function(Fraction, Metric) {
      summary_pair_t_test(
        data = fit_results,
        fraction = Fraction,
        metric = Metric,
        groups = ao_groups,
        analysis_set = "Adult vs Old",
        contrast = "Old vs Adult"
      )
    }
  )

old_tests <- tidyr::crossing(
  Fraction = fraction_levels,
  Metric = c("Plateau", "K")
) %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(
    function(Fraction, Metric) {
      purrr::pmap_dfr(
        old_contrasts,
        function(Contrast, Group_1, Group_2) {
          summary_pair_t_test(
            data = fit_results,
            fraction = Fraction,
            metric = Metric,
            groups = c(Group_1, Group_2),
            analysis_set = "Old planned contrasts",
            contrast = Contrast
          )
        }
      )
    }
  ) %>%
  group_by(Fraction, Metric) %>%
  mutate(
    P_adjusted = stats::p.adjust(P_value, method = "holm")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

print(ao_tests, n = Inf)
print(old_tests, n = Inf)

readr::write_csv(ao_tests, file.path(out_dir, "AO_tests.csv"))
readr::write_csv(old_tests, file.path(out_dir, "Old_planned_tests.csv"))
```

# Validate the Adult-versus-Old statistic against Prism

The existing Prism statistics file used an omnibus one-way ANOVA with Tukey comparisons for the old-treatment analysis. Because the current manuscript strategy intentionally replaces that workflow with two pre-specified treatment-versus-control contrasts, the legacy old-treatment Prism statistics are **not** used to validate the new treatment p-values. The Adult-versus-Old Plateau test is still validated against Prism.

```{r statistics-validation}
prism_stats <- readr::read_csv(prism_stats_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

ao_stats_validation <- ao_tests %>%
  filter(Metric == "Plateau") %>%
  select(
    Analysis_set,
    Fraction,
    Metric,
    Group_1,
    Group_2,
    Statistic_R = Statistic,
    DF_R = DF_denominator,
    P_R = P_value
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    prism_stats %>%
      filter(Analysis_set == "Adult vs Old") %>%
      select(
        Analysis_set,
        Fraction,
        Metric,
        Group_1,
        Group_2,
        Statistic_Prism = Statistic,
        DF_Prism = DF_denominator,
        P_Prism = P_value
      ),
    by = c(
      "Analysis_set",
      "Fraction",
      "Metric",
      "Group_1",
      "Group_2"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Statistic_difference = Statistic_R - Statistic_Prism,
    DF_difference = DF_R - DF_Prism,
    P_difference = P_R - P_Prism,
    Stats_pass =
      abs(DF_difference) < 1e-8 &
      abs(Statistic_difference) < 5e-4 &
      abs(P_difference) < 5e-4
  )

print(ao_stats_validation, n = Inf)
stopifnot(all(ao_stats_validation$Stats_pass))

readr::write_csv(
  ao_stats_validation,
  file.path(out_dir, "AO_stats_validation.csv")
)

old_validation_note <- tibble::tibble(
  Analysis = "Old treatments",
  Current_strategy = "Planned Exercise vs Control and Rapamycin vs Control contrasts",
  Legacy_Prism_strategy = "Ordinary one-way ANOVA plus Tukey all-pair comparisons",
  Validation = "Not directly comparable by design"
)

print(old_validation_note)
readr::write_csv(
  old_validation_note,
  file.path(out_dir, "Old_stats_validation_note.csv")
)
```

# Plotting functions

All turnover plots use explicit segment coordinates:

- Resistant is always on the bottom, from 0 to `100 * (1 - Plateau)`.
- Dynamic is always on top, from the Resistant boundary to 100%.
- Dynamic uses the transparent group fill.
- Resistant stays white with the group-colored border and stripe pattern.

Old-treatment bar plots show only the two pre-specified treatment-versus-control comparisons: Exercise versus Control and Rapamycin versus Control. No omnibus treatment p-value and no Exercise-versus-Rapamycin bracket are displayed.

```{r plotting-functions}
make_curve_plot <- function(fraction, groups, set_code) {
  d <- raw_fit %>%
    filter(Fraction == fraction, Group %in% groups) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = groups))

  time_summary <- d %>%
    group_by(Group, Time_days) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean = mean(Value),
      SD = stats::sd(Value),
      N = n(),
      SEM = if_else(N > 1 & is.finite(SD), SD / sqrt(N), NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  curve_grid <- purrr::map_dfr(groups, function(group_name) {
    new_data <- tibble(Time_days = seq(0, 60, length.out = 500))
    key <- paste(fraction, group_name, sep = "||")
    tibble(
      Group = factor(group_name, levels = groups),
      Time_days = new_data$Time_days,
      Fitted = as.numeric(
        stats::predict(fit_lookup[[key]], newdata = new_data)
      )
    )
  })

  plot_labels <- if (set_code == "AO") {
    unname(group_labels[groups])
  } else {
    unname(old_axis_labels[groups])
  }

  ggplot() +
    geom_line(
      data = curve_grid,
      aes(x = Time_days, y = Fitted, colour = Group),
      linewidth = nm_style$data_line
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = time_summary,
      aes(
        x = Time_days,
        ymin = Mean - SEM,
        ymax = Mean + SEM,
        colour = Group
      ),
      width = 0.8,
      linewidth = nm_style$data_line,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = time_summary,
      aes(x = Time_days, y = Mean, colour = Group, shape = Group),
      size = nm_style$point_medium
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = group_cols[groups],
      breaks = groups,
      labels = plot_labels
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = group_shapes[groups],
      breaks = groups,
      labels = plot_labels
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(0, 4, 8, 15, 30, 45, 60),
      limits = c(0, 61.5),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
      limits = c(0, 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(fraction, "Fraction New"),
      x = "Time (Days)",
      y = "Fraction New",
      colour = NULL,
      shape = NULL
    ) +
    theme_nm() +
    theme(
      legend.position = c(0.18, 0.79),
      legend.background = element_blank()
    )
}

make_planned_brackets <- function(groups, statistics, y_start, y_step, tip_size) {
  pair_order <- c(
    "Old Control||Old Exercise",
    "Old Control||Old Rapamycin"
  )

  statistics %>%
    mutate(
      Pair = paste(Group_1, Group_2, sep = "||"),
      Pair = factor(Pair, levels = pair_order),
      x1 = match(Group_1, groups),
      x2 = match(Group_2, groups),
      Plot_p = .data[[old_plot_p_column]]
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Pair)) %>%
    arrange(Pair) %>%
    mutate(
      y = y_start + (row_number() - 1) * y_step,
      y_tip = y - tip_size,
      y_text = y + 0.32 * y_step,
      Label = vapply(
        Plot_p,
        format_p,
        character(1),
        prefix = if (old_plot_p_column == "P_adjusted") "p_Holm" else "p"
      )
    )
}

add_bracket_layers <- function(plot, brackets, text_size = pt_to_geom(nm_style$stat_text)) {
  plot +
    geom_segment(
      data = brackets,
      aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = nm_style$bracket_line
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = brackets,
      aes(x = x1, xend = x1, y = y_tip, yend = y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = nm_style$bracket_line
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = brackets,
      aes(x = x2, xend = x2, y = y_tip, yend = y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = nm_style$bracket_line
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = brackets,
      aes(x = (x1 + x2) / 2, y = y_text, label = Label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = text_size
    )
}

make_pool_legend_data <- function() {
  tibble(
    xmin = c(NA_real_, NA_real_),
    xmax = c(NA_real_, NA_real_),
    ymin = c(NA_real_, NA_real_),
    ymax = c(NA_real_, NA_real_),
    Pool = factor(
      c("Dynamic", "Resistant"),
      levels = c("Dynamic", "Resistant")
    )
  )
}

add_pool_legend_scale <- function(plot) {
  plot +
    ggpattern::scale_pattern_manual(
      values = c("Dynamic" = "none", "Resistant" = "stripe"),
      limits = c("Dynamic", "Resistant"),
      breaks = c("Dynamic", "Resistant"),
      name = NULL,
      guide = guide_legend(
        byrow = TRUE,
        ncol = 1,
        override.aes = list(
          fill = c("#77777780", "white"),
          colour = c("#333333", "#333333"),
          pattern = c("none", "stripe"),
          pattern_colour = c("#333333", "#333333"),
          pattern_fill = c("#333333", "#333333")
        )
      )
    )
}

make_turnover_plot <- function(fraction, groups, set_code) {
  display <- fit_results %>%
    filter(Fraction == fraction, Group %in% groups) %>%
    mutate(
      Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = groups),
      x = match(as.character(Group), groups),
      Resistant_pct = 100 * Resistant,
      Dynamic_pct = 100 * Dynamic,
      Plateau_SE_pct = 100 * Plateau_SE,
      fill_col = unname(group_fill_cols[as.character(Group)]),
      border_col = unname(group_border_cols[as.character(Group)])
    ) %>%
    arrange(x)

  stopifnot(
    nrow(display) == length(groups),
    !anyNA(display),
    all(display$Resistant_pct >= 0),
    all(display$Dynamic_pct >= 0),
    all(abs(display$Resistant_pct + display$Dynamic_pct - 100) < 1e-8)
  )

  error_data <- display %>%
    transmute(
      x,
      border_col,
      ymin = 100 - Plateau_SE_pct,
      ymax = 100 + Plateau_SE_pct
    )

  legend_data <- make_pool_legend_data()

  plot <- ggplot() +
    ggpattern::geom_rect_pattern(
      data = display,
      aes(
        xmin = x - 0.31,
        xmax = x + 0.31,
        ymin = 0,
        ymax = Resistant_pct,
        colour = border_col,
        pattern_colour = border_col,
        pattern_fill = border_col
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "white",
      pattern = "stripe",
      pattern_angle = 45,
      pattern_density = 0.20,
      pattern_spacing = 0.035,
      pattern_linewidth = 0.12,
      linewidth = nm_style$data_line,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_rect(
      data = display,
      aes(
        xmin = x - 0.31,
        xmax = x + 0.31,
        ymin = Resistant_pct,
        ymax = 100,
        fill = fill_col,
        colour = border_col
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = nm_style$data_line,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = error_data,
      aes(x = x, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, colour = border_col),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      width = 0.20,
      linewidth = nm_style$data_line,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggpattern::geom_rect_pattern(
      data = legend_data,
      aes(
        xmin = xmin,
        xmax = xmax,
        ymin = ymin,
        ymax = ymax,
        pattern = Pool
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "white",
      colour = "#333333",
      pattern_fill = "#333333",
      pattern_colour = "#333333",
      pattern_angle = 45,
      pattern_density = 0.20,
      pattern_spacing = 0.035,
      pattern_linewidth = 0.12,
      linewidth = nm_style$data_line,
      show.legend = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_fill_identity(guide = "none") +
    scale_colour_identity(guide = "none") +
    ggpattern::scale_pattern_colour_identity(guide = "none") +
    ggpattern::scale_pattern_fill_identity(guide = "none")

  if (set_code == "AO") {
    stat_row <- ao_tests %>%
      filter(Fraction == fraction, Metric == "Plateau")
    bracket_y <- max(112, max(error_data$ymax) + 7)
    brackets <- tibble(
      x1 = 1,
      x2 = 2,
      y = bracket_y,
      y_tip = bracket_y - 3,
      y_text = bracket_y + 4,
      Label = format_p(stat_row$P_value)
    )
    y_max <- brackets$y_text + 4
    axis_labels <- unname(group_labels[groups])
    plot <- add_bracket_layers(plot, brackets)
  } else {
    stat_rows <- old_tests %>%
      filter(Fraction == fraction, Metric == "Plateau")
    bracket_start <- max(112, max(error_data$ymax) + 7)
    brackets <- make_planned_brackets(
      groups,
      stat_rows,
      y_start = bracket_start,
      y_step = 8.0,
      tip_size = 2.7
    )
    y_max <- max(brackets$y_text) + 5
    axis_labels <- unname(old_axis_labels[groups])
    plot <- add_bracket_layers(plot, brackets)
  }

  plot <- plot +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(groups),
      labels = axis_labels,
      limits = c(0.4, length(groups) + 0.7),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
      limits = c(0, y_max),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(fraction, "Turnover"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Turnover (%)"
    ) +
    theme_nm() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(1.0, "mm"),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(3.0, "mm"),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(3.0, "mm"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = nm_style$legend_text)
    )

  if (utils::packageVersion("ggplot2") >= "3.5.0") {
    plot <- plot + theme(legend.key.spacing.y = grid::unit(1.0, "mm"))
  }

  add_pool_legend_scale(plot)
}

make_synthesis_plot <- function(fraction, groups, set_code) {
  display <- fit_results %>%
    filter(Fraction == fraction, Group %in% groups) %>%
    mutate(
      Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = groups),
      x = match(as.character(Group), groups),
      fill_col = unname(group_fill_cols[as.character(Group)]),
      border_col = unname(group_border_cols[as.character(Group)])
    ) %>%
    arrange(x)

  stopifnot(nrow(display) == length(groups), !anyNA(display), all(display$K > 0))

  data_top <- max(display$K + display$K_SE)
  plot <- ggplot(display, aes(x = x, y = K)) +
    geom_col(
      aes(fill = fill_col, colour = border_col),
      width = 0.62,
      linewidth = nm_style$data_line
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = K - K_SE, ymax = K + K_SE, colour = border_col),
      width = 0.20,
      linewidth = nm_style$data_line
    ) +
    scale_fill_identity(guide = "none") +
    scale_colour_identity(guide = "none")

  if (set_code == "AO") {
    stat_row <- ao_tests %>%
      filter(Fraction == fraction, Metric == "K")
    bracket_y <- data_top * 1.12
    step <- data_top * 0.10
    brackets <- tibble(
      x1 = 1,
      x2 = 2,
      y = bracket_y,
      y_tip = bracket_y - step * 0.30,
      y_text = bracket_y + step * 0.40,
      Label = format_p(stat_row$P_value)
    )
    y_max <- brackets$y_text + step * 0.55
    axis_labels <- unname(group_labels[groups])
    plot <- add_bracket_layers(plot, brackets)
  } else {
    stat_rows <- old_tests %>%
      filter(Fraction == fraction, Metric == "K")
    step <- data_top * 0.18
    brackets <- make_planned_brackets(
      groups,
      stat_rows,
      y_start = data_top * 1.10,
      y_step = step,
      tip_size = step * 0.32
    )
    y_max <- max(brackets$y_text) + step * 0.55
    axis_labels <- unname(old_axis_labels[groups])
    plot <- add_bracket_layers(plot, brackets)
  }

  plot +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(groups),
      labels = axis_labels,
      limits = c(0.4, length(groups) + 0.4),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, y_max),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(fraction, "Synthesis"),
      x = NULL,
      y = expression(k~"(1/day)")
    ) +
    theme_nm() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
}
```

# Generate Adult-versus-Old figures

All dimensions below come from `nm_dims`. To resize any output, edit the corresponding entry in the **EASY RESIZING** block (chunk `nm-figure-config`) and rerun this section.

```{r adult-old-figures, fig.keep="none"}
plot_bank <- list()

for (fraction in fraction_levels) {
  code <- unname(fraction_codes[fraction])
  p_curve <- make_curve_plot(fraction, ao_groups, "AO")
  p_turn <- make_turnover_plot(fraction, ao_groups, "AO")
  p_syn <- make_synthesis_plot(fraction, ao_groups, "AO")

  save_nm_plot(
    p_curve,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("AO_", code, "_Frac")),
    size_key = "ao_curve"
  )
  save_nm_plot(
    p_turn,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("AO_", code, "_Turn")),
    size_key = "ao_turn"
  )
  save_nm_plot(
    p_syn,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("AO_", code, "_Syn")),
    size_key = "ao_syn"
  )

  row_plot <- p_curve + p_turn + p_syn +
    patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1.50, 1.0, 1.0), guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "right")

  save_nm_plot(
    row_plot,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("AO_", code, "_All")),
    size_key = "ao_row"
  )

  plot_bank[[paste("AO", fraction, sep = "||")]] <- row_plot
}

ao_overview <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  purrr::map(
    fraction_levels,
    ~ plot_bank[[paste("AO", .x, sep = "||")]]
  ),
  ncol = 1,
  guides = "collect"
) & theme(legend.position = "right")

save_nm_plot(
  ao_overview,
  file.path(out_dir, "AO_All"),
  size_key = "ao_overview"
)
```

# Verify plotted geometry and saved outputs

```{r plot-validation}
expected_stubs <- c(
  unlist(lapply(c("AO", "OT"), function(set_code) {
    unlist(lapply(unname(fraction_codes), function(code) {
      file.path(
        out_dir,
        paste0(
          set_code,
          "_",
          code,
          "_",
          c("Frac", "Turn", "Syn", "All")
        )
      )
    }))
  })),
  file.path(out_dir, c("AO_All", "OT_All"))
)

expected_pngs <- paste0(expected_stubs, ".png")
expected_svgs <- paste0(expected_stubs, ".svg")

stopifnot(
  length(expected_pngs) == 26,
  length(expected_svgs) == 26,
  all(file.exists(expected_pngs)),
  all(file.info(expected_pngs)$size > 1000),
  all(file.exists(expected_svgs)),
  all(file.info(expected_svgs)$size > 1000)
)

# Inspect the actual built coordinates for every turnover panel.
turnover_geometry <- purrr::map_dfr(
  list(
    AO = ao_groups,
    OT = old_groups
  ),
  function(groups) {
    purrr::map_dfr(fraction_levels, function(fraction) {
      p <- make_turnover_plot(
        fraction,
        groups,
        if (length(groups) == 2) "AO" else "OT"
      )
      built <- ggplot2::ggplot_build(p)$data
      resistant_layer <- built[[1]]
      dynamic_layer <- built[[2]]

      stopifnot(
        all(resistant_layer$ymin == 0),
        all(dynamic_layer$ymin == resistant_layer$ymax),
        all(dynamic_layer$ymax == 100),
        all(resistant_layer$fill == "white"),
        all(resistant_layer$pattern == "stripe"),
        identical(resistant_layer$pattern_fill, resistant_layer$colour),
        identical(resistant_layer$pattern_colour, resistant_layer$colour),
        !anyNA(dynamic_layer$fill),
        all(grDevices::col2rgb(dynamic_layer$fill, alpha = TRUE)[4, ] == 128),
        all(grDevices::col2rgb(dynamic_layer$colour, alpha = TRUE)[4, ] == 255)
      )

      tibble(
        Fraction = fraction,
        Group_index = seq_len(nrow(dynamic_layer)),
        Resistant_bottom = resistant_layer$ymin,
        Resistant_top = resistant_layer$ymax,
        Dynamic_bottom = dynamic_layer$ymin,
        Dynamic_top = dynamic_layer$ymax,
        Dynamic_fill = dynamic_layer$fill,
        Border = dynamic_layer$colour
      )
    })
  },
  .id = "Analysis_set"
)

readr::write_csv(
  turnover_geometry,
  file.path(out_dir, "Plot_validation.csv")
)

cat(
  "PASS: all 26 PNGs and all 26 editable SVGs exist; turnover geometry is valid; old-treatment plots use only the two planned treatment-versus-control contrasts.\n"
)
```
